subject: Gender Affirming and Reproductive Healthcare Ordinance
overview: The committee amended and approved a draft ordinance establishing Medford as a sanctuary for reproductive and gender-affirming healthcare, aligning local definitions with state law while strengthening protections against out-of-state litigation. The measure was referred to the full City Council for adoption.

items.title: Gender Affirming and Reproductive Healthcare Ordinance
items.summary: The committee deliberated on a draft ordinance to codify Medford as a sanctuary for reproductive and gender-affirming healthcare and provide legal protections for providers.

items.title: Definition of City Agent
items.summary: Approved a motion to include city officials and contractors in the definition of "City Agent" while removing recipients of city grants or awards to narrow the ordinance's administrative scope.

items.title: Definition of Gender Identity
items.summary: Approved a motion to strike descriptive language requiring medical history or documentation of identity to avoid potential vulnerabilities for residents seeking care.

items.title: Public Participation
items.summary: Multiple residents and business owners expressed support for the ordinance, citing the importance of proactive legal protections for bodily autonomy and community safety.

items.title: Purpose Statement and Referral
items.summary: Approved a revised purpose statement opposing the use of city resources to enforce out-of-state laws targeting healthcare and referred the amended ordinance to the April 8 regular City Council meeting.
